question: Can longer training or a wider image model improve the frozen anomaly detector after score-only changes failed to help?
scope: Research on the authorized erdos-3242 v5p-32 only. Training and likelihood inputs use normal training data and explicitly synthetic probes, without reading the public test for fitting or selection.

training.caveat: The cosine learning-rate schedule spans the new training budget, so this changes both training duration and schedule.

normal_audit.selection_rule: Lower mean normal-audit MSE across the two seeds, registered before anomaly evaluation.
normal_audit.interpretation: Approximately 0.25 percent lower normal squared error; not evidence of improved anomaly detection.

numerical_checks.gate: Median absolute 64-versus-128-step NLL difference below 0.3 percent of normal-pilot NLL standard deviation.
numerical_checks.limitation: Finite normal-data checks do not prove exact integration for all possible inputs.

normal_noise_diagnostic.limitation: The clean-image oracle uses information unavailable at inference. It is a diagnostic reference, not a deployable detector or an achievable-model performance claim.

likelihood_comparison.launch_recovery: An initial SSH exit 255 interrupted six launches. Missing units and free assigned chips were verified before starting the remaining six. Existing work was not restarted.
likelihood_comparison.next_action: Inspect this existing evaluation and retrieve its receipt/archive if complete before running analyze.py. Do not infer remote termination from a local observation failure.
